scoring.PASS: Exact/captured/recovered behavior with executable regression proof.
scoring.STRONG: Implementation/data connection is strongly evidenced but not yet exact native parity.
scoring.UNKNOWN: Unresolved native dependency group; always blocks 100% strict parity.
scoring.PARTIAL: Implemented compatibility/policy shell; reported separately and never receives parity credit.

Stock NPC HP regeneration uses an 18-combat-round interval and the decoded NPC record retains the authored hp_regen amount; exact live tick phase/order and out-of-combat behavior remain unresolved, so runtime activation is deferred.
Native perception, threat/hate, assist, flee, patrol/pathing, action priority, retry cadence and other original AI selection/timing rules remain unresolved.
Native NPC combat message 8480 remains evidence-blocked because caller-owned miss verb/body-part/weapon arguments are absent from retained evidence.
Combat/spells are non-native exhausted, but exact remaining native DLL/WCC/WBB formulas, branch semantics and ordering still block exact Classic parity.
Character runtime is exhausted except for native login/reconnect/link-dead/party/trade/offline-corpse lifecycle dependencies.
Exact native player command table, aliases, minimum prefixes, handlers and argument parsers remain a native dependency.
Stock item price currency types convert to copper at 1/10/100/10,000/1,000,000 before merchandise pricing. Live LIST/BUY/SELL consume the same decoded cost_type conversion.
Classic shop Markup% is additive: baseCopper + Fix(baseCopper*Markup/100); raw 0 is retail and raw 100 is +100%. The earlier 0162 direct-multiplier interpretation is corrected.
Live merchandise BUY converts the item currency to copper, applies additive shop markup, then the recovered Charm buy modifier and VB-style final rounding.
Live merchandise SELL starts from base item copper value, does not apply shop markup, and uses the recovered stock Charm sell formula.

Recovered stock buy Charm modifier is 1 - ((Fix(Charm/5)-10)/100), applied after shop markup. Exact cross-category equipment/permanent-stat contribution order into effective Charm remains separately unresolved.
Recovered stock sell Charm percentage is Fix(Charm/2)+25, applied to base item copper value with stock truncation and legacy overflow behavior.
Live level TRAIN debit uses recovered stock formula Fix((Level*5)*(Markup+100)/100)*10 copper with target-level index minus one, then persists the debit with promotion.
Live BUY/SELL pair character copper settlement with persistent shop-stock mutation under the existing transaction boundary; exact native failure-message and commit ordering remain unproven.
Repair, spell-service and other non-recovered service price stage ordering, minimums, discounts/refunds and final native rounding still require wccmmud/WCC-WBB callsite proof.

The reciprocal side is Hidden/Searchable and move rug/pull rug are directly decoded, but the native opening mutation, repeatability, reset timing, and failure message remain unproven.

POWERS renders the native Level/Kai/Short/Spell Name table shape.

COMMANDS and HELP COMMANDS render the decoded WCCMMHLP native command-category payload.

The Shadowy Healer fixed spawn at Map 1 Room 2325 uses the observed native one-hour regeneration value rather than the generated fifteen-minute room delay.

Ordinary room Delay values are projected in minutes, matching recovered MajorMUD tooling, but the exact wall-clock-minute gate and room-entry admission semantics are not yet proven.

Runtime resting HP recovery uses the recovered 20-second cadence; exact native tick phase/host-clock interaction remains evidence-gated.
Runtime meditation recovery uses the recovered 10-second cadence; exact native tick phase/host-clock interaction remains evidence-gated.
Stock MajorMUD physical combat advances on a five-second round and the authoritative host combat scheduler now uses 5000 ms.
Decoded spell/status durations and periodic ticks use the recovered three-second spell/system round instead of borrowing the physical combat clock.
Stock physical hit/AC uses the recovered squared defense/accuracy equation with an 8% floor, 99% cap, and zero-defense cap behavior.
Stock Dodge uses the recovered accuracy divisor, 95% cap, accuracy threshold, Backstab /5 reduction, and inclusive percentile boundary.

Stock weapon energy applies the recovered base equation, below-STR-requirement penalty and actual encumbrance percentage before 1000-energy round scheduling, carry-forward remainder, and the five-swing cap.
Strength contributes Fix((STR-50)/10) to maximum physical damage with native truncation behavior.
Natural critical chance and post-bonus diminishing returns/cap match the recovered stock formulas.
Critical percentile boundaries and recovered critical range/order are executable through the single Classic combat resolver.
Quick & Deadly uses recovered attack-energy, Agility, 20-point cap, and encumbrance-halving behavior.
Stock Backstab accuracy matches the recovered Stealth/Agility, BS accuracy, class/race stealth and normal-accuracy formula.
Bash and Smash use the recovered accuracy penalties, pre-roll modifiers, post-DR multipliers, critical suppression and energy scheduling.
The recovered Backstab endpoint formula is live and regression-tested, but its current evidence grade remains strongly corroborated rather than strict native closure.
Weapon range, pre-roll special scaling, damage resistance and non-negative final damage are live; general native physical damage ordering remains strongly corroborated.
Decoded class combat rating feeds the live accuracy profile, but exact remaining native base-stat ordering is not promoted to strict parity.

The recovered attack-energy Speed-percent branch is executable, but the exact native live source/value for non-default player Speed adjustment remains evidence-gated; normal combat keeps the native 100% default branch.
Native-traced character Max HP creation formula, including duplicate constitution adjustment, class/race terms, accumulated HP roll pool, and MaxHP modifier, is executable.
Native-traced Max Mana/Kai semantics are executable: nonmagic 0, magic types 1-4 use MagicLevel*Level*2 + 6 plus explicit modifiers/cache, and type 5 uses Level-1.
One-level promotion applies proven HP roll/constitution growth and native mana growth by magic type.
Decoded race/class experience percentage modifiers are applied before XP ledger persistence.
Verified modified Stealth builder uses level, AGI, INT, Charm, class/race ownership adjustments, and Ability 27.
Normal/resting HP regeneration uses retained MMUD Explorer Level/Health formulas and HPRegen percentage; exact native timer phase remains unresolved.
Mana regeneration and meditation use magic-type casting stat, MagicLevel, Level, and MPRegen evidence; exact type-5 branch/timer phase remains below PASS.
Live character MR now uses retained CalcMR weighting Fix((INT + WIL*3)/4) + modifiers across NPC and player spell resistance consumers.
Live player raw Dodge now uses recovered Level/Charm/Agility/PlusDodge formula and the below-33-percent encumbrance bonus before proven Dodge-vs-Accuracy resolution.
Direct acquired-ability/equipment projections are de-duplicated at combat consumers so projected totals are not counted twice; full cross-category native order remains unresolved.

Stock Picklocks formula branch ownership is resolved: Classic uses the retained Pascal Level/AGL/INT formula; the competing CHA-bearing branch is GreaterMUD-only. Runtime now applies the stock base when ability 37 grants Picklocks and composes acquired/equipment/status PickLocksValue bonuses without double counting.
Exact race/class vs acquired ability vs equipment vs aura/status contribution ordering remains unresolved beyond explicit promoted mappings.
Classic characters start with 9 lives and 9 is the maximum lives value.
A normal Classic death costs exactly one life; native SUICIDE help states that suicide has the same effects as normal death and costs one life.

Training/level-up restores exactly one life up to the 9-life cap. Runtime promotion now persists +1 life with a hard cap of 9; operator observation remains the exact stock behavioral evidence pending native binary callsite recovery.
When no lives remain, the Classic character dies permanently and cannot be used again.
Death loses experience, but the exact native XP-loss formula, rounding, caps and ordering remain unresolved.
On death, carried possessions are dropped into the death room and overflow can spill to another room when floor capacity is reached; exact adjacent-room selection/order remains to be recovered.

Operator-observed Classic behavior routes good/non-outlaw death respawn to Temple, Halls of the Dead (map 1/2189) and Outlaw-or-worse to Earthen Tomb (map 1/142); both decoded rooms are now hard-wired into the live death-respawn path. Exact native alignment branch callsite remains untraced.
MajorMUD has one Sysop role; Worldgroup security keys configured through WCCMMUD.INI gate individual MajorMUD sysop commands. Exact complete command/key mapping still requires INI/native exhaustion.
Classic MajorMUD has no native in-game content builder; content editing is external (for example Nightmare Redux). Final negative native command-table proof is still required before PASS.
Decoded attack_count is the authored executable attack-row count, not attacks per combat round.
An attacking NPC receives six attack-selection attempt slots per 5-second combat round.
Decoded monster Energy is gained each combat round; carried energy starts at zero and unused energy carries forward without a one-round cap.
Each NPC attempt uses one inclusive d100 against authored Att% thresholds in slot order; unaffordable rows are not removed or re-normalized.
For Type-2 direct spell rows, AttAcc is spell id, AttMax is cast level, and AttMin is cast-success percent with a separate inclusive d100 cast roll.
Failed or fully resisted direct Type-2 NPC casts consume Round(energy/2,0) with midpoint-to-even rounding; physical misses/dodges retain full cost.
Retained Classic simulators end the NPC round after a Type-1 physical selection when remaining energy is below that selected row cost; Type-2 spell rows do not use this branch.

The Classic exit-trap catalog preserves exactly 295 canonical traps: 273 fixed-damage traps and 22 spell traps, one per decoded exit identity with exact damage/spell operands.
Decoded fixed-damage exit traps execute through the sole live Classic exit-trap consumer and lethal results route through the authoritative player defeat/death path.

Live movement resolves the exit trap after successful movement/departure and before arrival/room rendering. Runtime ordering is explicit, but exact original MajorMUD native ordering still requires final executable proof.

Stock absolute XP thresholds are recovered and live: class ExpTable+100 plus race ExpTable selects the chart; the exact stock level multipliers/divisors and recovered 32-bit rollover/billions tabulation produce the threshold used by EXP and TRAIN. Native executable callsite proof is still required for PASS.

Stock level-up CP award schedule is recovered and live: each promotion to target level L awards (((L-1) div 10)*5)+10 CP. Runtime TRAIN uses this schedule and persists the award. Native executable callsite proof is still required for PASS.
